description: Publish a listing on behalf of the user across any of the 4 verticals and 12 roles. `location` must be coordinates ({ lat, lon }) — a free-text address is not accepted, so geocode it first. Publishing consumes credits and requires a free listing slot; get_entitlements reports the current balance and remaining slots. A reached limit makes this return an ACTIVE_LISTING_LIMIT_REACHED error carrying a pay_url. Consumes credits and is held for AI moderation (status starts "pending"); credits are refunded if rejected, EXCEPT for prohibited or spam content, which forfeits the credit. To attach photos, first call request_image_upload for each image and pass the returned keys in `images` — every image is AI-moderated with the text before going live. Requires the user to be connected to Teppek: an anonymous call returns an AUTH_REQUIRED error with an authorize_url — surface "Connect with Teppek" to the user, then retry.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code matching the listing country (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, TRY). Required — there is no default, to avoid silently mislabeling non-Turkish listings.

description.description: Full listing text, up to 5000 characters. Facts that fit a `details` key belong in details as well. Example: "Bright flat on the third floor, five minutes from the metro."

details.description: Vertical-specific attributes. Only these exact keys for the listing's vertical are accepted; any other key is rejected with an error. career: organization_name, employment_type, salary_min, salary_max, years_experience. real_estate: property_room_count, m2_gross, m2_net, building_age, floor_number, heating_type, deposit, dues, is_furnished, is_student_friendly, is_credit_eligible, tapu_status. vehicle: brand, model, vehicle_model_year, vehicle_mileage_km, fuel_type, gear_type, color, damage_status, daily_price, deposit. service: service_category. employment_type is one of full_time, part_time, contract, freelance, internship. is_furnished, is_student_friendly and is_credit_eligible are booleans. real_estate also accepts transaction_type (sale, rent or hire). Example: { "brand": "Toyota", "model": "Corolla", "vehicle_model_year": 2021, "vehicle_mileage_km": 40000, "fuel_type": "hybrid", "gear_type": "manual" }.

images.description: Up to 6 image keys returned by request_image_upload, uploaded before this call. Example: ["7c9e6679-7425-40de-944b-e07fc1f90ae7"].

location.description: Listing coordinates as { lat, lon }. A free-text address is NOT accepted — resolve it to coordinates before calling. Example: { "lat": 48.85, "lon": 2.35 }.

price.description: Asking price as a plain number in `currency`, with no separators. For a job, use the salary figure and put the range in details.salary_min and details.salary_max. Example: 950.

role.description: The listing role — this alone fixes supply vs demand (do not send intent_type). vehicle_letter = you OWN the vehicle and are renting it OUT (lessor); for a user who WANTS to rent a vehicle use vehicle_renter. Likewise estate_landlord (renting out) vs estate_renter (wants to rent), estate_seller vs estate_buyer, career_employer (posting a job) vs career_seeker (a CV), service_pro (offering) vs service_client (wants a service).

title.description: Short headline of the listing, 3-200 characters. Example: "Two-bedroom flat near the river".

vertical.description: Listing category, which must match the role: career (jobs and CVs), real_estate, vehicle or service. Example: "vehicle".

name: create_listing
